arguments.text: 8000 m, 1000 m out-and-back legs. Goal fastest finish: near-even effort at TRUE critical power (CP), reserve empty at the line, finish sprint ~500 m out. 1) min 1-4: settle from the hard start; see where pod power settles vs CP 155 W shaft. 2) min 4-15: check CP with heart-rate trend at steady effort (measure); set beliefs; maybe a test piece. 3) Watch incidents: GPS speed drop at same pod power and HR (weed -> clear_rudder); pod power vs HR/speed mismatch (pod drift -> pod_gain belief); radio course change (set_race_distance + tell). 4) Final 1-2 km: spend what is left; finish cue ~500 m.
